biology.feeding-data-graph.0003.a: aphid numbers decrease with time; rapidly at first then levelling off; quote data e.g. ~700 at 0 to ~100 at 6 weeks
biology.feeding-data-graph.0003.b: ladybirds are predators that eat aphids; aphid deaths exceed births; as aphids fall, ladybirds have less food/harder to find so decrease slows

biology.feeding-data-pct.0002.b: energy lost as heat in respiration; not all eaten (e.g. bones); undigested in faeces; excretion (urine)

biology.feeding-data-plot.0003.b: decrease; rapid at first then slows; levels off near 100 aphids; quote data 720 at 0 to 99 at 6 weeks

biology.feeding-data-read.0002.b: about 2760-300 = ~2460 kJ per m2 per year
biology.feeding-data-read.0002.c: respiration heat loss; not all eaten; faeces/excretion

biology.feeding-describe.0002.all: always pyramid shaped, widest at producers, narrowing at each level, never inverted; because energy is lost at each level (heat from respiration, faeces, uneaten parts), only ~10% passed on

biology.feeding-describe-multi.0006.b: producers trap light energy as chemical energy in glucose/biomass; consumers eat organisms and energy passes in food; at each level energy lost as heat in respiration, faeces etc.

biology.feeding-explain.0003.all: energy lost at each trophic level (~90%) through respiration/heat, faeces; eating plants means one fewer trophic level so more energy available to humans; more people fed per area of land

biology.feeding-explain-multi.0008.b: fewer trophic levels; energy lost at each level as heat/respiration; more energy available

biology.feeding-mcq.0002.all: one large producer can support many consumers

biology.feeding-recall.0002.all: heat from respiration; faeces/undigested material; excretion; parts not eaten

biology.gas-exchange-humans-data-graph.0.a: more cigarettes per day, more lung cancer deaths; positive, roughly linear/proportional; quote data
biology.gas-exchange-humans-data-graph.0.b: tar contains carcinogens; cause mutations in DNA of lung cells; uncontrolled cell division forms tumour

biology.gas-exchange-humans-data-pct.000.b: carcinogens in tar; mutation; uncontrolled division/tumour

biology.gas-exchange-humans-data-plot.00.a: axes, scale, points, line of best fit
biology.gas-exchange-humans-data-plot.00.b: deaths increase as cigarettes increase; positive linear correlation; quote 9 at 0 and 297 at 35

biology.gas-exchange-humans-data-read.00.a: read resting rate from graph (~12-15 breaths/min)
biology.gas-exchange-humans-data-read.00.b: (reading at 6 - reading at 0)/6 breaths per min per min
biology.gas-exchange-humans-data-read.00.c: muscles respire more, need more oxygen and produce more CO2; CO2 must be removed; increased breathing raises gas exchange; also anaerobic/oxygen debt

biology.gas-exchange-humans-describe.000.all: external intercostal muscles contract, ribs move up and out; diaphragm contracts and flattens; thorax volume increases; pressure in lungs falls below atmospheric so air drawn in

biology.gas-exchange-humans-describe-mul.b: tar contains carcinogens - lung cancer; tar paralyses/damages cilia and increases mucus, so mucus builds up - coughing, bronchitis, infections; damages alveoli walls - emphysema, reduced surface area

biology.gas-exchange-humans-explain.0005.all: keeps removing oxygenated blood and bringing CO2-rich blood; maintains steep concentration gradient for diffusion of O2 into and CO2 out of blood
